verdict.rationale: Amplitude's docs explicitly describe an auto-instrumentation SDK that captures page views, clicks, and sessions 'out of the box' (amplitude-docs-4), plus a wizard/CLI that auto-installs the SDK and fires a test event with no manual coding (amplitude-docs-1, amplitude-docs-27). This directly matches the story of code-free capture of clicks/pageviews/form interactions. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that autocapture works flawlessly out of the box (one community comment notes integration can be 'very hard' and data 'often wrong', amplitude-comm-3), and no explicit confirmation of automatic form-interaction capture beyond clicks/pageviews.
